title: Project & Finance Professional
subtitle: Lead projects, control cost and schedule, and model the numbers — with AI as your co-pilot
description:
Projects succeed when scope, schedule, cost and people are managed together. This path covers all four. You begin with project management leadership, including how AI assistants help with planning, risk registers and stakeholder updates. Project controls follow: earned value, schedule analysis and forecasting, with AI used to spot variances early. Project finance and financial modelling teach you to build and stress-test the models that decide whether projects go ahead.

You then sharpen data analysis and decision-making with AI, adopt everyday AI productivity habits, and strengthen the leadership and communication that keep teams aligned. The path ends with a structured approach to preparing for professional certification exams. Every course is free and ends with a certificate for your LinkedIn profile.
outcomes: Plan and lead projects with clear scope, risks and stakeholder communication
Control cost and schedule with earned value and early-warning analysis
Build and stress-test project finance models
Use AI to analyse data and prepare decision-ready summaries
Prepare efficiently for professional certification exams
audience: Project managers, planners and cost controllers
